sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sheikh Mohammad Ali Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Pankaj Kumar Jaiswal,J.
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Heard Sri Sheikh Mohammad Ali, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Manish Mishra, learned Standing Counsel for the State respondents.

By this writ petition, the petitioner is praying for issuance of writ of mandamus directing the respondent nos. 2 and 3 to issue appropriate direction for grant of license for selling the Buffalo meat to the petitioner.

Petitioner has filed an application for grant of license, vide annexure no. 1, under the provisions of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 and the regulations made thereunder but till date his application has not been decided by the authority concerned and, therefore, prayer has been made to decide the same expeditiously.
Gufran vs State Of U.P. Thru Prin.Secy. Food And

entities.text: Gufran vs State Of U.P. Thru Prin.Secy. Food And
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Sri Manish Mishra, learned Standing Counsel has submitted that if the application of the petitioner is still pending and the same is complete in all respect, then, the same will be decided in the light of the order of this Court dated 12.5.2017 passed in Writ Petition (M/B) No. 8293 of 2017.

Considering the aforesaid, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the competent authority respondent no. 3-District Magistrate, Barabanki is directed to consider and decide the application of the petitioner for registration of license, if the same is complete in all respect, in accordance with law, in the light of the order dated 12.5.2017 passed by this Court in Writ Petition (M/B) No. 8293 of 2017, within a period of one month from the date of production of certified copy of this order before him by a reasoned and speaking order.

With the aforesaid, writ petition is disposed of.
.

(Karunesh Singh Pawar, J.) (Pankaj Kumar Jaiswal, J.) Order Date :- 20.1.2020 Ajit/-
